description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class named 'TaxClassController' managing CRUD operations for tax classes within an e-commerce admin panel. It handles listing, paging, creation, updating, editing, and removal of tax class entities, as well as setting up relevant UI menus and access controls.

classes.name: TaxClassController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing CRUD operations and UI interactions for TaxClass entities in admin panel.

methods.name: displayTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of tax classes, initializing the model with a new TaxClass object.

methods.name: pageTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch paginated list of tax classes as a JSON response, excluding the default tax class.

methods.name: saveTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST form submission to create a new TaxClass after validation checks for code uniqueness and defaults.

methods.name: updateTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to update existing TaxClass, ensuring code uniqueness and default constraints.

methods.name: removeTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a tax class, ensuring it is not associated with existing products.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Handles GET request to load a specific TaxClass for editing based on its ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu items for the admin UI.
